_doc: Training profile for a 4× NVIDIA H200 box (141GB each). device/selfplay.device=auto uses CUDA when present and CPU otherwise (Mac, CI). The loop trains on one GPU. Self-play workers spread inference across selfplay.gpus cards. If nvidia-smi shows the cards full, free them first or set CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Keys starting with _ are documentation and are stripped on load.

paths._doc: Relative to the process working directory.

encode._doc: Input tensor is float32 CHW (C, 10, 9). C = history_length * (7*our + 7*opp) + extras. perspective_current_player rotates the board 180° when Black to move so the side to act always sits on rank 0; value v is that side's expected outcome in [-1, 1].

action._doc: from_to: index = from_sq * 90 + to_sq in network coordinates (already flipped if Black to move). Illegal slots are masked before softmax. size must stay 8100 for this encoding.

network._doc: AlphaZero dual-head residual tower, chess-paper size (20×256). A 10×9 board plus this tower is tiny on H200; the limit is self-play MCTS, not VRAM.

mcts._doc: 800 simulations matches the AlphaZero chess/shogi setting. reuse_tree keeps the played-move subtree inside one game. Trees are not written into training checkpoints.

selfplay._doc: 256 games / 32 workers ≈ 8 processes per H200. Each worker loads its own net. device=auto spreads workers with cuda:(id % gpus) when CUDA exists, otherwise CPU. If cards are busy, set gpus to the number of free cards or CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Inference is still one position at a time, so many workers matter more than a huge batch.

replay._doc: 500k positions ≈ a few GB of RAM. min_size waits until the first iteration has enough games to train.

train._doc: One H200 can hold a much larger batch than 4096; this size is already plenty for a 20×256 tower on 10×9. Adam stays the default because it is stabler before the replay pool is huge.

eval._doc: Challenger is the learner; incumbent is best. Self-play always uses best. The learner replaces best only when win_rate >= threshold, so a weaker trainee does not generate the next games. Eval is sequential on the training GPU. Keep n_games modest and eval_every > 1 so it does not dominate wall time.

play._doc: Local visualization UI only. Does not affect self-play or the training loop.

rules._doc: Must stay in sync with the C++ engine. Threefold is adjudicated: perpetual check / chase lose; idle or mutual offence draws. no_progress_halfmoves 120 is a draw.
